description: This file defines an Android Activity class 'PointerLocation' that displays pointer location information using the 'PointerLocationView'. It also sets the screen brightness to full when the activity is created.

classes.name: PointerLocation
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays pointer location visualization and sets full screen brightness.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view to a PointerLocationView, and adjusts window brightness to full.
